title: hieracium froelichianum subsp. fariniceps
intro: Hieracium froelichianum subsp. fariniceps, commonly known as Hawkweed, is a species of flowering plant in the sunflower family. It is used in traditional medicine due to its potential health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties. The plant is said to exhibit therapeutic actions such as wound healing, antimicrobial, and antiseptic properties, attributed to its bioactive constituents like flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins. However, further research is needed to confirm the efficacy and safety of using Hieracium froelichianum subsp. fariniceps for medicinal purposes.
